findings.text: Google Ads spent $502.48 over 28 days with 0 conversions and 114 clicks — confirmed spend leak with zero measurable return.
5 OVERDUE MILESTONES across GHL, Ops, Web, and Creative — oldest due 2026-07-20; each is a live scaling or attribution blocker.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads immediately — $502.48 spent, 0 conversions over 28 days is confirmed zero-return spend.
